evidence: chapter-19/chapter-19.md:221 groups cap-T / prefix caching / FP8 KV as levers that 'relax the KV-capacity ceiling'. evidence: chapter-21/chapter-21.md:65 merges two metrics in one bullet: 'Gate pass rate / false-promotion rate - how often a gated change later regresses in production; a rising value means the evaluation suite is losing fidelity.' That definition and causal reading fit only false-promotion rate; pass rate = passed/candidates has a different denominator and can rise because candidates improved or thresholds loosened.
fix_instruction: At chapter-21/chapter-21.md:65 split the bullet: 'Gate pass rate - passed candidates / candidates (a throughput signal); false-promotion rate - passed candidates that later regress / passed candidates (the fidelity signal; a rising value means the suite is losing fidelity)'.
